newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - CHILANGA VOLUMES SURGE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - CHILANGA VOLUMES SURGE.

text.p: Traded volume on the Lusaka Stock
Exchange increased by twelvefold last week, mainly as a result
of hefty trade in Chilanga Cement.
The exchange said total traded volumes surged to 6.3 million
shares valued at 748.3 million kwacha, compared with 563,492
shares valued at 22.7 million kwacha in the previous week.
Chilanga Cement rose 22.5 kwacha to close at 130
kwacha, on traded volume of 5.5 million shares valued at 713.6
million kwacha.
The counter's gains contributed to a 10.19 percent rise in
the index which ended at 219.67.
"The index has risen 119.67 percent in the six months to
date from January 2, 1997. This performance far exceeds the
gains in other sub-Saharan exchanges so far this year," an
exchange official said.
Elsewhere, Rothmans fell five kwacha to end the
week at 50 kwacha and saw 30,447 shares valued at 1.8 million
kwacha exchanging hands.
Zambia Sugar rose three kwacha to close at 35 kwacha
with 453,022 shares valued at 15.6 million kwacha exchanging
hands.
Zambian Breweries rose 45 kwacha to end the week at
275 kwacha in a traded volume of 54,261 shares valued at around
13.2 million kwacha.
Farmers House, Trans-Zambezi Industries,
and Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines were untraded
during the week.
